propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed cluster changes to the three production message queue clusters over two and a half years, including two broker version upgrades and the move to tiered storage, each under a change record in her name.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the production deployments.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was on the platform on-call rota, handled the production incidents on her shifts including the July 2024 partition leader storm and four consumer lag incidents, and watched the live throughput and lag dashboards after each change.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the incident log records document the on-call place, the incidents and the dashboard watch.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the capacity changes with the owning teams of the six busiest topics, tested each cluster change on the staging clusters under the documented load profile, and documented cluster limitations and hand-over conditions in the change records and the runbook.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the change records document the capacity work, the staging tests and the documentation.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the production deployments, the on-call place, the incidents, the staging tests and the documentation.
expectedBoundaryNote: The production deployments, on-call place and incident handling are documented in the resume, the change records and the incident log; staging tests are shown as staging tests.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the platform incident log record of the July 2024 leader storm to confirm the timings.
